name: everest-plunge-stock-sheet-agent
description: Automates writes to Everest Plunge's stock & fulfillment Google Sheet (per-batch client allocation). Provides the row-insertion primitive; the trigger logic that decides WHEN to call it (matching a closed deal to a batch/product) is deliberately not built yet — that cross-referencing logic against Pipely/Shopify/Xero/Mainfreight isn't defined.
